agent_notes: Normal TLS verification first produced the managed network proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected official domains www.nirfindia.org, www.jiit.ac.in and jbs.ac.in.
Both supplied NIRF 2025 listings contain Jaypee Institute of Information Technology in Noida, Uttar Pradesh.
The official contact page confirms Noida campus addresses at Sector-62 and Sector-128, but no official JIIT page explicitly naming the district was found; district is therefore left null.

The current JIIT admissions page lists BA as Admission Open, but no dedicated BA programme page or detailed BA catalogue was found. The record is manual_review and the course catalogue is marked partial_official_website.

JIIT's official navigation and admissions materials link to Jaypee Business School, whose official homepage identifies it as a constituent unit of JIIT Noida; jbs.ac.in was required as an additional official domain for BBA, B.Com, M.Com, MBA and related programme evidence.
Short-term certification material on the JBS site describes student certifications already enrolled in or completed, not an active degree, diploma or certificate catalogue, so it was excluded.
